channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Jury Remains Deadlocked in Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial
item.description: Jurors have not reached a verdict in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman charged with killing her three children.

item.title: US Open: American players impress early
item.description: ABC News' Sophie Flay reports on the U.S. Open, where American players have performed strongly in the opening rounds.

item.title: Lightning strike survivor shares his story
item.description: ABC News' Hanna Battah interviews the survivor of a lightning strike, who recounts the incident that was captured on video.

item.title: Mullin's plane makes emergency landing after engine failure
item.description: Mullin praised the Coast Guard pilots for their calm handling of the single-engine landing, calling it 'straight professionalism' on X.
